title: When does the Mahotsav begin, is there any limit to how long I can stay, and how much time should I plan for my visit?

segments.text: Mahotsav Dates: The 25-day Mahotsav officially begins on 12th September 2026. ​Arriving Early: Depending on personal convenience and travel schedules, visitors are welcome to arrive early. Some guests choose to come 2 days early, while others arrive up to a week in advance. You are free to plan your arrival according to what works best for you. ​Recommended Duration & Flexibility ​Minimum Recommended Stay (2–3 Days): We strongly encourage all visitors to plan for at least a 2 to 3-day stay. Due to the large number of devotees attending, the queues and lineups can be long. Staying for a minimum of 2 to 3 days ensures that Gurudev and Parikshit Bhaiya can dedicate quality time to you and that you have a genuine opportunity to speak with Parikshit Bhaiya personally. ​Ideal Experience (Full 25 Days): While you are free to stay for as long as your schedule permits, it is ideal to stay for the entire 25-day duration to perform your sadhana and fully immerse yourself in the spiritual environment. ​Extending Stay Beyond the Festival: ​If you wish to extend your stay and remain at Ashaeiynn beyond the official conclusion of the Mahotsav, you must inform your assigned mentor.
